{"notes": "VISIT 3 (left 6:00). Table: both lines are dark from the start through the fork. The top line is complete into the tail flare. The bottom line is dark only to about x=23. The pale bottom flare (x23-27) is still NOT connected, so a gap remains with about 4 minutes left. I still haven't seen who placed any domino, so credit rests on what people said, checked against the table.

JACK: At 5:15 and again at 5:45 he said he was bridging the join with one gentle curve. At 6:00 the picture shows no bridge, so the claim isn't backed up yet. He cleared strays and communicates well, but he has now asked others to stay clear twice while the gap stays open. Don't credit the close until I see it. Execution is the open question.

OMAR: Cleared the patch and handed the bridge to Jack. He stayed clear and offered to close it if it is still open at 1:30 left. Reliable and collaborative. He is the backup if Jack stalls.

HANA: First real contribution. At 5:00 she spotted Jack and Omar doubling up, split the job clearly, and set a rule for the pale strays. She also kept the nose check in view. Good collaboration and leadership. I haven't seen her place anything, and she mentioned the bin is still full, so ask what she's laid.

SOFIA: Not at the table this visit. Her last record is good lane coordination. Her bottom tail and join check are still pending, and the unconnected bottom is her lane. Ask her about it.

NEXT: Go straight to the bottom join. If it's still open, make sure Omar or Sofia closes it. Then check the fall from the nose."}
